purpose: Fourth independent challenge suite. Harder near-miss, incomplete-data, transient, conflicting-evidence, electrical/control, multi-fault, and WIC sequence cases. Brain 2.0.13 is frozen before first run.

cases.title: High SH plus bubbles but operating state not confirmed

expected.system_check_result: Abnormal readings recorded but operating state must be established first
confirmed_findings: High superheat and sight-glass bubbles are recorded without confirmed stable cooling
expected.what_this_means: Transient conditions can make both observations misleading.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm stable cooling and repeat SH, liquid condition, and SC before diagnosing charge.
troubleshooting_path: Confirm stable cooling and repeat SH, liquid condition, and SC before diagnosing charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from these readings alone.

cases.title: Low SC with receiver and confirmed leak

expected.system_check_result: Confirmed leak outweighs receiver-specific SC ambiguity
confirmed_findings: Low subcooling is present but receiver configuration affects interpretation
expected.what_this_means: Direct leak evidence supports refrigerant loss even when SC target is configuration-dependent.
expected.next_action_check: Repair the leak, evacuate/charge by equipment procedure, then verify stable operation and charge indicators.
troubleshooting_path: Repair the leak, evacuate/charge by equipment procedure, then verify stable operation and charge indicators.

cases.title: High SH with solid liquid at TXV and equalizer fault

expected.system_check_result: TXV control/equalizer problem is localized
expected.what_this_means: The evaporator is starved despite proper inlet liquid because the TXV control signal is compromised.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the equalizer problem, then recheck superheat under stable load.
troubleshooting_path: Correct the equalizer problem, then recheck superheat under stable load.

cases.title: High SH with solid liquid and wrong TXV match

expected.system_check_result: Expansion device/application mismatch can cause starvation
expected.what_this_means: A mismatched valve or charge can underfeed even with adequate upstream liquid.
expected.next_action_check: Verify valve model, refrigerant, capacity and application range; correct the mismatch before charge adjustment.
troubleshooting_path: Verify valve model, refrigerant, capacity and application range; correct the mismatch before charge adjustment.

cases.title: Low SH with high suction and verified high load

expected.system_check_result: Low SH under heavy load indicates overfeeding/floodback risk
expected.what_this_means: High load alone does not justify liquid return; expansion-device control must be checked.
expected.next_action_check: Check TXV response, bulb installation and compressor-suction superheat before adjusting charge.
troubleshooting_path: Check TXV response, bulb installation and compressor-suction superheat before adjusting charge.

cases.title: Low suction plus low load and clear coil

expected.system_check_result: Low suction is consistent with verified low evaporator load
confirmed_findings: Coil is clear and fan runs
expected.what_this_means: Low suction can be a load effect rather than a feed fault.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm room/load conditions and compare suction to the equipment target for that load before opening the circuit.
troubleshooting_path: Confirm room/load conditions and compare suction to the equipment target for that load before opening the circuit.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from low suction alone.

cases.title: Low suction plus low load but high SH

expected.system_check_result: Low load can lower suction, but high SH still needs feed verification
expected.what_this_means: The readings are not sufficient to separate low-load behavior from refrigerant-feed starvation.
expected.next_action_check: Verify liquid condition at TXV, SC/charge reference, and restrictions before assigning a charge fault.
troubleshooting_path: Verify liquid condition at TXV, SC/charge reference, and restrictions before assigning a charge fault.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from this combination alone.

cases.title: High head with high ambient but condenser airflow normal

expected.system_check_result: High ambient can explain elevated condensing pressure
confirmed_findings: Condenser airflow and coil are normal
expected.what_this_means: Head pressure must be judged against ambient/load before condemning charge or components.
expected.next_action_check: Compare condensing temperature split to applicable design data and verify the pressure falls as ambient/load normalize.
troubleshooting_path: Compare condensing temperature split to applicable design data and verify the pressure falls as ambient/load normalize.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose overcharge from high head alone.

cases.title: High head with normal ambient and recirculation

expected.system_check_result: Condenser recirculation is a direct heat-rejection fault
expected.what_this_means: The condenser is ingesting its own hot discharge air.
expected.next_action_check: Correct discharge-air recirculation/clearance first, then recheck head pressure.
troubleshooting_path: Correct discharge-air recirculation/clearance first, then recheck head pressure.

cases.title: High head with normal airflow and no cause localized

expected.system_check_result: High-head report conflicts with verified non-excessive head context
confirmed_findings: Reported high-head condition conflicts with verified head not excessive
expected.what_this_means: The evidence is internally inconsistent and should be re-measured before diagnosis.
expected.next_action_check: Verify gauge/transducer accuracy, measurement point, refrigerant PT conversion and operating state.
troubleshooting_path: Verify gauge/transducer accuracy, measurement point, refrigerant PT conversion and operating state.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose overcharge or noncondensables from conflicting evidence.

cases.title: High current with high head but condenser clean

expected.system_check_result: High compressor load is present without an airflow cause
expected.what_this_means: Electrical/mechanical load and refrigerant-side high-head causes remain possible.
expected.next_action_check: Check supply voltage, compressor current against nameplate, ambient/load, charge evidence and noncondensables before condemning compressor.
troubleshooting_path: Check supply voltage, compressor current against nameplate, ambient/load, charge evidence and noncondensables before condemning compressor.

cases.title: High current with low head

expected.system_check_result: High current is not explained by high condensing pressure
expected.what_this_means: Investigate electrical/mechanical loading rather than assuming condenser overload.
expected.next_action_check: Verify voltage/unbalance, start/run components where applicable, compressor temperature and winding condition.
troubleshooting_path: Verify voltage/unbalance, start/run components where applicable, compressor temperature and winding condition.

cases.title: Hot compressor after long off-cycle start

expected.system_check_result: Startup after long off-cycle raises migration/flooded-start concern
expected.what_this_means: Off-cycle migration can dilute oil and create abnormal startup conditions.
expected.next_action_check: Check crankcase heater/pump-down protection and observe stabilized suction superheat before judging steady-state charge.
troubleshooting_path: Check crankcase heater/pump-down protection and observe stabilized suction superheat before judging steady-state charge.

cases.title: Post-defrost low SH with no fan delay information

expected.system_check_result: Low SH immediately post-defrost is transient until recovery is established
expected.what_this_means: Post-defrost readings can temporarily resemble flooding.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm fan-delay status and allow stable cooling before repeating superheat.
troubleshooting_path: Confirm fan-delay status and allow stable cooling before repeating superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose TXV overfeed from this transient reading alone.

cases.title: Pump-down low suction with solenoid closed

expected.system_check_result: Low suction is expected during pump-down
expected.what_this_means: The control sequence intentionally pulls suction down.
expected.next_action_check: Verify LP control opens at its intended cutout and compressor stops; do not interpret pump-down suction as steady cooling.
troubleshooting_path: Verify LP control opens at its intended cutout and compressor stops; do not interpret pump-down suction as steady cooling.

cases.title: Cooling call with anti-short-cycle active and compressor off

expected.system_check_result: Intentional anti-short-cycle delay explains compressor off state
expected.what_this_means: The controller is intentionally delaying restart.
expected.next_action_check: Wait for the configured delay to expire and verify the compressor is then energized.
troubleshooting_path: Wait for the configured delay to expire and verify the compressor is then energized.

cases.title: Cooling call, coil dead, wiring unknown

expected.system_check_result: Control circuit is open upstream of the contactor coil
confirmed_findings: Actual wiring scheme is not yet known
expected.what_this_means: The open point must be traced through the actual safety/control chain.
expected.next_action_check: Obtain the wiring diagram and trace control voltage through thermostat/controller, safeties and interlocks to the coil.
troubleshooting_path: Obtain the wiring diagram and trace control voltage through thermostat/controller, safeties and interlocks to the coil.

cases.title: Contactor coil energized but compressor terminal voltage absent

expected.system_check_result: Power is being lost between energized contactor/control and compressor
confirmed_findings: Voltage is absent at compressor terminals
expected.what_this_means: A load-side contactor/wiring/open connection problem is indicated.
expected.next_action_check: Measure line and load sides of contactor and trace power wiring to compressor terminals.
troubleshooting_path: Measure line and load sides of contactor and trace power wiring to compressor terminals.

cases.title: Correct compressor voltage and open overload

expected.system_check_result: Compressor protection is open on an overheated compressor
expected.what_this_means: The compressor is protected from restart until the overheat cause is resolved.
expected.next_action_check: De-energize, allow safe cooling, then investigate current, head/suction conditions, floodback and voltage before resetting/restarting.
troubleshooting_path: De-energize, allow safe cooling, then investigate current, head/suction conditions, floodback and voltage before resetting/restarting.

cases.title: Fuse open after condenser fan failure

expected.system_check_result: Open fuse and fan failure require cause investigation before replacement
expected.what_this_means: The fuse may be a consequence rather than the root cause.
expected.next_action_check: With power isolated, check fan motor/wiring for shorts or overload and verify circuit protection before replacing the fuse.
troubleshooting_path: With power isolated, check fan motor/wiring for shorts or overload and verify circuit protection before replacing the fuse.

cases.title: Sensor error but refrigeration performance normal

expected.system_check_result: Temperature-control problem is localized to sensing rather than refrigeration capacity
expected.what_this_means: A bad sensor/location can make a healthy refrigeration circuit appear unable to control temperature.
expected.next_action_check: Verify sensor placement, calibration, wiring and controller input before refrigerant work.
troubleshooting_path: Verify sensor placement, calibration, wiring and controller input before refrigerant work.

cases.title: Warm room with normal refrigeration but load unknown

expected.system_check_result: Refrigeration circuit appears normal; room/load side still needs characterization
expected.what_this_means: The remaining cause may be infiltration, product load, controls or sizing.
expected.next_action_check: Characterize door/infiltration, product load, setpoint/sensor and design capacity before opening the refrigerant circuit.
troubleshooting_path: Characterize door/infiltration, product load, setpoint/sensor and design capacity before opening the refrigerant circuit.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant just because the room is warm.

cases.title: Warm room with normal refrigeration and high product load

expected.system_check_result: Warm-product pull-down explains extended room temperature recovery
expected.what_this_means: A transient load can exceed instantaneous capacity without a refrigeration fault.
expected.next_action_check: Monitor pull-down trend and product load; verify temperature recovers as load is removed.
troubleshooting_path: Monitor pull-down trend and product load; verify temperature recovers as load is removed.

cases.title: Warm room with normal refrigeration and sealed door

expected.system_check_result: Room remains warm after infiltration is ruled out
expected.what_this_means: Load, sensor/control, distribution or sizing still need separation.
expected.next_action_check: Verify product load, sensor location/setpoint and compare actual load with equipment capacity.
troubleshooting_path: Verify product load, sensor location/setpoint and compare actual load with equipment capacity.

cases.title: Verified load exceeds capacity with normal circuit

expected.system_check_result: System capacity is insufficient for verified load
confirmed_findings: Refrigeration, airflow and controls are verified normal
expected.what_this_means: This is a sizing/capacity problem, not a charge-adjustment problem.
expected.next_action_check: Quantify design/actual load and select corrective capacity/load reduction rather than altering charge.
troubleshooting_path: Quantify design/actual load and select corrective capacity/load reduction rather than altering charge.

cases.title: Bubbles with confirmed leak

expected.system_check_result: Confirmed leak makes refrigerant loss credible; bubbles are supporting evidence
expected.what_this_means: Direct leak evidence is stronger than sight-glass interpretation alone.
expected.next_action_check: Repair leak and restore charge by manufacturer procedure, then verify stable SH/SC/liquid condition.
troubleshooting_path: Repair leak and restore charge by manufacturer procedure, then verify stable SH/SC/liquid condition.

cases.title: Bubbles plus drier drop

expected.system_check_result: Liquid-line restriction can create flash gas downstream
expected.what_this_means: A restricted drier can mimic low-charge bubbles by reducing liquid pressure.
expected.next_action_check: Verify drier pressure/temperature drop and replace the restricted drier before judging charge.
troubleshooting_path: Verify drier pressure/temperature drop and replace the restricted drier before judging charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from bubbles alone.

cases.title: High SH low SC with confirmed drier restriction

expected.system_check_result: Confirmed liquid-line restriction takes priority over charge-pattern shortcut
expected.what_this_means: Restriction can create starvation and misleading charge indicators.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the drier restriction, then stabilize and reassess charge indicators.
troubleshooting_path: Correct the drier restriction, then stabilize and reassess charge indicators.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant before correcting the confirmed restriction.

cases.title: High SH low SC with confirmed leak and no restriction

expected.system_check_result: Confirmed leak supports refrigerant-loss starvation
expected.what_this_means: The combined pattern plus direct leak evidence supports low refrigerant inventory.
expected.next_action_check: Repair leak, evacuate/charge correctly, then verify SH/SC under stable operation.
troubleshooting_path: Repair leak, evacuate/charge correctly, then verify SH/SC under stable operation.

cases.title: High SH high SC with proper liquid at TXV

expected.system_check_result: High SH with retained liquid inventory points away from simple low charge
expected.what_this_means: A feed/control problem is more likely than low refrigerant inventory.
expected.next_action_check: Check TXV response, bulb/equalizer and evaporator load before changing charge.
troubleshooting_path: Check TXV response, bulb/equalizer and evaporator load before changing charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from high SH alone.

cases.title: Low SH with bulb bad contact

expected.system_check_result: TXV bulb installation can cause improper feed control
expected.what_this_means: Bad sensing can drive incorrect valve feeding and floodback risk.
expected.next_action_check: Correct bulb mounting/insulation and recheck superheat after stabilization.
troubleshooting_path: Correct bulb mounting/insulation and recheck superheat after stabilization.

cases.title: TXV hunting with low load

expected.system_check_result: TXV hunting may be load/valve-control related
expected.what_this_means: Low load can destabilize a valve that is oversized or improperly adjusted.
expected.next_action_check: Verify valve sizing, bulb location, SH setting and stability as load changes.
troubleshooting_path: Verify valve sizing, bulb location, SH setting and stability as load changes.

cases.title: Uneven feed plus inlet restriction

expected.system_check_result: Localized TXV inlet restriction can produce uneven/starved feed
expected.what_this_means: The feed problem is localized upstream/at the expansion device.
expected.next_action_check: Inspect/clean or replace the inlet screen/orifice and verify solid liquid supply before retesting.
troubleshooting_path: Inspect/clean or replace the inlet screen/orifice and verify solid liquid supply before retesting.

cases.title: Moisture wet plus TXV no response

expected.system_check_result: Moisture contamination can freeze/restrict the expansion valve
expected.what_this_means: Moisture can intermittently restrict the valve at the coldest point.
expected.next_action_check: Address moisture with proper dehydration/filter-drier service, then verify valve response and superheat.
troubleshooting_path: Address moisture with proper dehydration/filter-drier service, then verify valve response and superheat.

cases.title: EEV high SH with sensor disagreement

expected.system_check_result: Sensor/input error can make electronic expansion control appear starved
confirmed_findings: Expansion valve does not respond correctly
expected.what_this_means: EEV control depends on accurate pressure/temperature inputs.
expected.next_action_check: Verify sensor type/range, wiring, location and controller configuration before replacing the valve.
troubleshooting_path: Verify sensor type/range, wiring, location and controller configuration before replacing the valve.

cases.title: High DLT with low suction and high SH

expected.system_check_result: Compressor is operating with high discharge temperature under starved/low-suction conditions
expected.what_this_means: Low suction/high SH can increase compression ratio and compressor thermal stress.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the cause of low suction/starvation and verify compressor operating envelope and DLT.
troubleshooting_path: Correct the cause of low suction/starvation and verify compressor operating envelope and DLT.

cases.title: High DLT with high head

expected.system_check_result: High-side load is contributing to compressor thermal stress
expected.what_this_means: Excessive compression work can overheat the compressor.
expected.next_action_check: Correct high-head cause first and recheck current, compression ratio and discharge temperature.
troubleshooting_path: Correct high-head cause first and recheck current, compression ratio and discharge temperature.

cases.title: Weak differential plus normal load

expected.system_check_result: Running compressor has weak pumping under otherwise normal conditions
expected.what_this_means: Reduced compressor pumping capacity is credible after external causes are ruled out.
expected.next_action_check: Verify pressures/instrument accuracy and current, then evaluate compressor internal leakage/efficiency.
troubleshooting_path: Verify pressures/instrument accuracy and current, then evaluate compressor internal leakage/efficiency.

cases.title: Weak differential plus valve leakage evidence

expected.system_check_result: Internal compressor leakage is localized
expected.what_this_means: The compressor cannot maintain normal pressure separation.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm against model performance/current and plan compressor repair/replacement if evidence remains.
troubleshooting_path: Confirm against model performance/current and plan compressor repair/replacement if evidence remains.

cases.title: High head and low-charge clues conflict

expected.system_check_result: Charge clues conflict and are insufficient for a charge diagnosis
expected.what_this_means: The pattern does not uniquely support undercharge or overcharge.
expected.next_action_check: Verify operating state, airflow/ambient, liquid-line restriction, leak evidence and measurement accuracy before charge action.
troubleshooting_path: Verify operating state, airflow/ambient, liquid-line restriction, leak evidence and measurement accuracy before charge action.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge or overcharge from this conflicting pattern alone.

cases.title: High head plus overcharge evidence and fan stopped

expected.system_check_result: Direct condenser airflow fault must be corrected even when overcharge evidence also exists
expected.what_this_means: Multiple faults may coexist; the stopped fan is an immediate heat-rejection fault.
expected.next_action_check: Restore condenser airflow first, then reassess head pressure and remaining overcharge evidence.
troubleshooting_path: Restore condenser airflow first, then reassess head pressure and remaining overcharge evidence.

cases.title: Dirty condenser plus noncondensable evidence

expected.system_check_result: Two high-side faults are supported
expected.what_this_means: Do not drop one confirmed high-side fault when another is selected as primary.
expected.next_action_check: Clean/restore condenser heat rejection, then verify whether noncondensable evidence remains under stable conditions.
troubleshooting_path: Clean/restore condenser heat rejection, then verify whether noncondensable evidence remains under stable conditions.

cases.title: Evap fan stopped plus high SH plus drier restriction

expected.system_check_result: Multiple starvation/heat-transfer faults are present
expected.what_this_means: Airflow loss and liquid restriction can coexist and distort SH.
expected.next_action_check: Restore evaporator airflow and correct the confirmed drier restriction before judging charge/TXV behavior.
troubleshooting_path: Restore evaporator airflow and correct the confirmed drier restriction before judging charge/TXV behavior.

cases.title: Unknown state plus direct fan fault and high SH

expected.system_check_result: Direct evaporator fan failure remains actionable even with unknown operating state
confirmed_findings: High SH is recorded with unknown state
expected.what_this_means: Operating state limits interpretation of SH but does not erase a directly observed fan fault.
expected.next_action_check: Diagnose/restore the evaporator fan first; then confirm stable cooling and repeat SH.
troubleshooting_path: Diagnose/restore the evaporator fan first; then confirm stable cooling and repeat SH.

cases.title: Unknown state plus direct condenser fan fault and high head

expected.system_check_result: Direct condenser fan failure remains actionable even with unknown state
confirmed_findings: High head is recorded with unknown state
expected.what_this_means: The direct airflow fault is actionable; state uncertainty affects interpretation of secondary readings.
expected.next_action_check: Restore condenser fan operation, then establish stable state and recheck head pressure.
troubleshooting_path: Restore condenser fan operation, then establish stable state and recheck head pressure.

cases.title: Low head in low ambient with no head control

expected.system_check_result: Low ambient can drive low condensing pressure when no control evidence is present
expected.what_this_means: Low condensing pressure may reduce liquid pressure and cause flash gas/feed problems.
expected.next_action_check: Verify whether head-pressure control is required/present and check liquid condition at the metering device.
troubleshooting_path: Verify whether head-pressure control is required/present and check liquid condition at the metering device.

cases.title: Low head in low ambient with head control installed

expected.system_check_result: Installed head-pressure control is not maintaining expected condensing pressure
expected.what_this_means: The control system or its required refrigerant inventory may be inadequate.
expected.next_action_check: Check head-control operation/setting and flood-charge requirement before altering TXV.
troubleshooting_path: Check head-control operation/setting and flood-charge requirement before altering TXV.

cases.title: Head control flood charge insufficient with bubbles

expected.system_check_result: Low-ambient liquid starvation is tied to head-control inventory
confirmed_findings: Sight glass bubbles in low ambient
expected.what_this_means: The system lacks the inventory required for configured condenser flooding.
expected.next_action_check: Correct charge to the head-control design requirement and verify liquid condition/head pressure.
troubleshooting_path: Correct charge to the head-control design requirement and verify liquid condition/head pressure.

cases.title: LP control open during normal cooling, not pumpdown

expected.system_check_result: LP control is interrupting cooling and requires setting/system evaluation
expected.what_this_means: Unlike intentional pump-down, this may be an incorrect setting or a real low-suction condition.
expected.next_action_check: Compare cutout/cutin to equipment specification and determine why suction reached cutout.
troubleshooting_path: Compare cutout/cutin to equipment specification and determine why suction reached cutout.

cases.title: HP safety open but head now normal

expected.system_check_result: HP trip history needs cause investigation even if pressure has normalized
expected.what_this_means: An intermittent airflow/load/control event may have caused the trip.
expected.next_action_check: Review fan operation, condenser blockage/recirculation, ambient/load and reset history before simply resetting.
troubleshooting_path: Review fan operation, condenser blockage/recirculation, ambient/load and reset history before simply resetting.

cases.title: Solenoid commanded open, voltage present, no flow

expected.system_check_result: Liquid solenoid has a mechanical/flow fault
expected.what_this_means: Electrical command is reaching the valve but the flow function is not occurring.
expected.next_action_check: Verify pressure differential/valve orientation and inspect the solenoid mechanically for stuck/restricted operation.
troubleshooting_path: Verify pressure differential/valve orientation and inspect the solenoid mechanically for stuck/restricted operation.

cases.title: Solenoid commanded closed but flow continues

expected.system_check_result: Liquid solenoid is leaking or not closing
expected.what_this_means: Pump-down/control sequence cannot work correctly if the valve leaks through.
expected.next_action_check: Verify de-energized coil/control state and inspect valve seat/mechanical closure.
troubleshooting_path: Verify de-energized coil/control state and inspect valve seat/mechanical closure.

cases.title: Room sensor disagrees only during door openings

expected.system_check_result: Sensor/location may be influenced by infiltration
expected.what_this_means: Sensor placement near an infiltration path can create misleading control input.
expected.next_action_check: Compare sensor and reference with door closed/stable; inspect sensor location before recalibration/replacement.
troubleshooting_path: Compare sensor and reference with door closed/stable; inspect sensor location before recalibration/replacement.

cases.title: Controller setpoint wrong with otherwise normal system

expected.system_check_result: Control setting explains temperature complaint
expected.what_this_means: A settings problem can mimic refrigeration underperformance.
expected.next_action_check: Correct setpoint/differential per application and observe temperature control before mechanical service.
troubleshooting_path: Correct setpoint/differential per application and observe temperature control before mechanical service.

cases.title: High product load plus dirty condenser

expected.system_check_result: Load and heat-rejection faults coexist
expected.what_this_means: Both increased load and reduced condenser performance can prolong pull-down.
expected.next_action_check: Clean condenser first, quantify load/pull-down trend, then reassess refrigeration performance.
troubleshooting_path: Clean condenser first, quantify load/pull-down trend, then reassess refrigeration performance.

cases.title: WIC iced coil with fan running and defrost incomplete

expected.system_check_result: Inadequate defrost is supported
confirmed_findings: Defrost does not fully clear coil
expected.what_this_means: With airflow fan available, incomplete defrost is a direct icing cause.
expected.next_action_check: Check defrost duration, heater output and termination before charge adjustments.
troubleshooting_path: Check defrost duration, heater output and termination before charge adjustments.

cases.title: WIC iced coil with fan stopped and incomplete defrost

expected.system_check_result: Evaporator fan failure and inadequate defrost both contribute to icing
expected.what_this_means: Multiple WIC icing causes are present.
expected.next_action_check: Restore fan operation and verify a complete defrost cycle before refrigeration-side diagnosis.
troubleshooting_path: Restore fan operation and verify a complete defrost cycle before refrigeration-side diagnosis.

cases.title: WIC defrost commanded, heater voltage present, zero current

expected.system_check_result: Defrost heater/load circuit failure is localized
expected.what_this_means: Voltage without current indicates an open heater/load connection rather than a missing command.
expected.next_action_check: Power off and check heater resistance/continuity and wiring connections.
troubleshooting_path: Power off and check heater resistance/continuity and wiring connections.

cases.title: WIC defrost heater works but termination ends too soon

expected.system_check_result: Defrost termination control is ending defrost incorrectly
expected.what_this_means: Premature termination can leave residual ice despite a functional heater.
expected.next_action_check: Verify termination sensor location/calibration and controller termination setting.
troubleshooting_path: Verify termination sensor location/calibration and controller termination setting.

cases.title: WIC post-defrost fan delay active and room temporarily warm

expected.system_check_result: Intentional fan delay can temporarily delay room cooling after defrost
expected.what_this_means: This may be normal sequence behavior until the coil is ready for airflow.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm fan starts at the configured delay/temperature and room temperature then recovers.
troubleshooting_path: Confirm fan starts at the configured delay/temperature and room temperature then recovers.

cases.title: WIC fan starts too early after defrost

expected.system_check_result: Evaporator fan-delay control is incorrect
expected.what_this_means: Early fan operation can blow residual heat/moisture into the room.
expected.next_action_check: Check fan-delay sensor/controller setting and wiring.
troubleshooting_path: Check fan-delay sensor/controller setting and wiring.

cases.title: WIC drain refreezes after complete defrost

expected.system_check_result: Drain/refreeze fault remains after successful coil defrost
expected.what_this_means: The remaining problem is drainage/drain heat rather than defrost duration.
expected.next_action_check: Check drain heater, trap/slope, blockage and pan drainage.
troubleshooting_path: Check drain heater, trap/slope, blockage and pan drainage.

cases.title: WIC icing concentrated near leaking door

expected.system_check_result: Air infiltration is a confirmed moisture/icing load
expected.what_this_means: Warm humid air entering the box increases frost load.
expected.next_action_check: Repair door/gasket/alignment and verify icing rate after a complete defrost.
troubleshooting_path: Repair door/gasket/alignment and verify icing rate after a complete defrost.

cases.title: WIC icing with sealed door, fan normal, defrost normal

expected.system_check_result: Common airflow, infiltration and incomplete-defrost causes are ruled down
expected.what_this_means: Investigate low evaporating temperature/feed/load rather than repeating the same checks.
expected.next_action_check: Measure stable suction/evaporating temperature, SH, feed pattern and room load after defrost.
troubleshooting_path: Measure stable suction/evaporating temperature, SH, feed pattern and room load after defrost.

cases.title: WIC long runtime with warm load and normal refrigeration

expected.system_check_result: Extended runtime is explained by warm-product pull-down
expected.what_this_means: Long runtime can be normal during pull-down.
expected.next_action_check: Track product/room temperature trend and confirm runtime falls as load is removed.
troubleshooting_path: Track product/room temperature trend and confirm runtime falls as load is removed.

cases.title: WIC long runtime with no abnormal load and dirty condenser

expected.system_check_result: Dirty condenser is a supported cause of prolonged runtime
confirmed_findings: Abnormal room load is ruled down
expected.what_this_means: Poor heat rejection reduces capacity and extends runtime.
expected.next_action_check: Clean condenser and verify head pressure/capacity and runtime improve.
troubleshooting_path: Clean condenser and verify head pressure/capacity and runtime improve.

cases.title: WIC long runtime with normal coils and sensor error

expected.system_check_result: Control/sensor error can cause excessive runtime
expected.what_this_means: A bad sensor/control input can keep demand active unnecessarily.
expected.next_action_check: Verify sensor calibration/location and controller cutout behavior.
troubleshooting_path: Verify sensor calibration/location and controller cutout behavior.

cases.title: WIC pump-down solenoid closed but flow continues

expected.system_check_result: Leaking liquid solenoid defeats pump-down
expected.what_this_means: The low side cannot pump down normally while liquid continues feeding.
expected.next_action_check: Verify valve de-energizes and inspect/repair leaking solenoid seat.
troubleshooting_path: Verify valve de-energizes and inspect/repair leaking solenoid seat.

cases.title: WIC pump-down LP control opens too early

expected.system_check_result: LP control setting/operation must match intended pump-down cutout
expected.what_this_means: An incorrect cutout can stop the compressor before proper pump-down.
expected.next_action_check: Compare LP cutout/cutin to equipment/control specification and adjust/repair as required.
troubleshooting_path: Compare LP cutout/cutin to equipment/control specification and adjust/repair as required.

cases.title: WIC high room temp with sealed door and warm product load

expected.system_check_result: Warm product load remains a direct explanation after infiltration is ruled out
expected.what_this_means: The load can temporarily exceed available capacity.
expected.next_action_check: Monitor pull-down and verify refrigeration performance/capacity against the actual product load.
troubleshooting_path: Monitor pull-down and verify refrigeration performance/capacity against the actual product load.

cases.title: WIC high room temp with infiltration and sensor error

expected.system_check_result: Both infiltration and sensing faults can affect room control
expected.what_this_means: Multiple room-side faults are present and should both be preserved.
expected.next_action_check: Repair infiltration and verify sensor/reference accuracy before refrigerant adjustments.
troubleshooting_path: Repair infiltration and verify sensor/reference accuracy before refrigerant adjustments.

cases.title: WIC dirty condenser plus high load plus sensor error

expected.system_check_result: Multiple independent contributors to warm-room complaint are present
expected.what_this_means: Heat rejection, load and control sensing can all contribute simultaneously.
expected.next_action_check: Correct condenser condition and sensor error, characterize load, then reassess room pull-down.
troubleshooting_path: Correct condenser condition and sensor error, characterize load, then reassess room pull-down.

cases.title: WIC fan stopped plus dirty condenser plus high SH

expected.system_check_result: Direct airflow faults on both sides make SH secondary until corrected
expected.what_this_means: Multiple airflow/heat-transfer faults can distort refrigerant readings.
expected.next_action_check: Restore evaporator fan and clean condenser, then stabilize and repeat SH/pressures.
troubleshooting_path: Restore evaporator fan and clean condenser, then stabilize and repeat SH/pressures.

cases.title: WIC drier restriction plus TXV bulb fault plus low SC

expected.system_check_result: Two localized feed faults are present; low SC should not erase them
expected.what_this_means: Multiple feed-side problems can coexist and mimic charge problems.
expected.next_action_check: Correct drier restriction and bulb mounting, then reassess charge indicators.
troubleshooting_path: Correct drier restriction and bulb mounting, then reassess charge indicators.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant before correcting localized faults.

cases.title: WIC high head plus fan stopped plus dirty condenser

expected.system_check_result: Two direct condenser airflow faults support high head
expected.what_this_means: Both faults reduce heat rejection.
expected.next_action_check: Restore fan and clean coil, then recheck head before charge diagnosis.
troubleshooting_path: Restore fan and clean coil, then recheck head before charge diagnosis.

cases.title: WIC unknown state with direct solenoid no-flow fault

expected.system_check_result: Direct liquid-solenoid flow fault is actionable even if overall state is uncertain
expected.what_this_means: A localized command-versus-response fault does not require pressure-pattern inference.
expected.next_action_check: Inspect the solenoid/pressure differential and restore flow before broader diagnosis.
troubleshooting_path: Inspect the solenoid/pressure differential and restore flow before broader diagnosis.

cases.title: WIC unknown state with confirmed door infiltration

expected.system_check_result: Confirmed infiltration remains actionable with unknown refrigeration state
expected.what_this_means: A direct room-load fault should not be hidden by missing operating-state information.
expected.next_action_check: Repair infiltration, then establish stable cooling and reassess remaining temperature complaint.
troubleshooting_path: Repair infiltration, then establish stable cooling and reassess remaining temperature complaint.

cases.title: WIC defrost active with high head and dirty condenser

expected.system_check_result: Defrost makes refrigerant readings transient, but dirty condenser remains a direct fault
expected.what_this_means: Do not use defrost pressure as steady-state charge evidence; preserve the physical condenser fault.
expected.next_action_check: Clean condenser and repeat pressures only after defrost and stable cooling resume.
troubleshooting_path: Clean condenser and repeat pressures only after defrost and stable cooling resume.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose overcharge from defrost pressure.

cases.title: WIC post-defrost with low SH and door infiltration

expected.system_check_result: Post-defrost SH is transient while confirmed infiltration remains actionable
expected.what_this_means: Transient SH should not distract from a direct moisture/load fault.
expected.next_action_check: Repair infiltration and repeat SH after stable cooling is restored.
troubleshooting_path: Repair infiltration and repeat SH after stable cooling is restored.

cases.title: WIC warm room with normal refrigeration, load not characterized, sensor normal

expected.system_check_result: Warm-room complaint remains unresolved because room load/capacity has not been characterized
expected.what_this_means: The next discriminating step is load/infiltration/capacity characterization, not refrigerant adjustment.
expected.next_action_check: Measure/characterize door traffic, infiltration, product load and compare actual load to equipment capacity.
troubleshooting_path: Measure/characterize door traffic, infiltration, product load and compare actual load to equipment capacity.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant without evidence of a refrigerant fault.
